surviving_mechanisms.name: R_LOCK_RANK_EFFECT
surviving_mechanisms.evidence: Spearman -0.59/-0.54; subperiods 2023 (-0.52/-0.54) 2024 (-0.66/-0.54); estimator sensitivity E0-E3 stable; rolling windows stable; monotone buckets 87%→7%
surviving_mechanisms.note: Effect is real but entirely driven by gap distance (G); expected excursion normalization adds no incremental information

surviving_mechanisms.name: BALANCE_PREDICTOR
surviving_mechanisms.evidence: Brier 0.208 vs null 0.250; log-loss 0.612 vs null 0.693; strongest categorical predictor
surviving_mechanisms.note: Directional balance is a descriptive state variable, not a mechanism

rlock_falsification.verdict: R_LOCK is a robust rank effect but does NOT add incremental predictive information beyond raw gap distance

state_compression.note: G and RLOCK dominate; all Atomic state variables (tier, 3am, loop, balance) add marginal value at best

program_routing.recommendation: Seal ASE development as failed. No rescue chain.
program_routing.note: The CCE (Constraint Capacity Engine) hypothesis is falsified: capacity ratio adds no info beyond gap distance. The broader Atomic transition engine hypotheses are all falsified. Directional balance is a strong descriptive predictor but not a mechanism.
